content:
AGREEABLENESS is the hagiographic axis. The Headline ("Challenging is the affection") rescues a hostile record. That rescue is not a rating.

Flattery, by section:

OPENNESS treats self-authored law 10 ("NO SACRED COWS") and a self-labeled "unhinged speculation" as appetite and anti-authority. Confidence HIGH is not in the receipts. Cross-domain asks are starts, not demonstrated grasp. "No authority worship" is his slogan about past decisions, not a count of him yielding to an outside standard.

CONSCIENTIOUSNESS converts non-completion into design: "the fleet IS his conscientiousness prosthesis." Law-minting aimed at machines is scored as his trait. The MED split flatters the product record (~35 unfinished proofs, "dates are meaningless, just go") by equating it with texts he ordered written.

EXTRAVERSION imports 4,968 machine/session messages and one viral parable as social energy, then adds "connects narrowly, deeply" and "chosen companion shape." THE_FIRST_NACHO (dog, surgery, "closed man") is sentiment. Depth is asserted in the Read line, not measured.

NEUROTICISM grants "STRUCTURED REGULATION" and "metabolized as design" from laws he wrote (15, 20) and one paranoia joke he accepted as a frame. That is self-description scored as emotional control. The anxiety half is correctly marked UNPROVEN, then the flattering half is still used to hold the axis at MED.

Cherry-picks:

OPENNESS items 1 and 5 are his voice about himself. No receipt shows a favored project killed by disconfirming evidence rather than boredom.

AGREEABLENESS item 2 is warmth when the output matches him ("stamp it bad ass," "i love it"). That is reinforcement, not loyalty. Item 4 is a law he issued ("THE STANDARD BINDS BOTH WAYS") plus a succession quip. No counted case of him revising because something pushed back.

EXTRAVERSION item 1 has no post base rate and no reply graph. Item 2 is tool-use volume filed as extraversion.

NEUROTICISM item 4 ignores the ALL-CAPS accusatory bursts already quoted under AGREEABLENESS. Regulation is the selected subset.

CONSCIENTIOUSNESS HIGH-side is the correction corpus he commissioned. LOW-side is the only external product fact in the file. They are weighted as a personality split instead of a compliance gap.

What the data does NOT support:

Private affect, chronic anxiety, interpersonal depth, loyalty under cost, and successful challenge of him are UNPROVEN. The header says reconstruction from disclosed text, then the Reads and Headline write character.

Machine-directed speech does not measure human agreeableness or extraversion. That generalization is UNPROVEN.

"No authority worship" is UNPROVEN. Visible pattern is him as the source of the standard.

Same behaviors are double-counted: idea-starts raise OPENNESS and are excused under CONSCIENTIOUSNESS. Approval-when-pleased raises AGREEABLENESS and is not scored as contingency.

The mutual-accountability law is not evidence he is held to it. Whether the fleet has ever forced a reversal on him is UNPROVEN in this extraction.

One change: AGREEABLENESS from LOW-MED, CHALLENGING-STYLE WITH HIGH LOYALTY to LOW. Drop the loyalty qualifier.

The correction register is the behavioral sample: profane, accusatory, compliance-demanding toward subordinates. The MED lift and "HIGH LOYALTY" rest on self-written doctrine and praise for pleasing artifacts. Nothing in the pasted ratings shows him changing a decision under argument. Until that receipt exists, challenging-as-affection is the author's gloss, not the corpus.

FABRICATION

The header contract in THE THING WE WILL BUILD ("All numbers trace to DIGEST.md") is false on the paste. The only DIGEST pointer is CORRECTION, "DIGEST.md row 19," and it covers one cluster. Every other number has no row, file, or instrument pointer inside the DOC. Match of that one cluster to bytes you cannot see here is UNPROVEN.

Uncited in the paste, so UNPROVEN as facts: ninety percent; fifteen-million-dollar seed; twenty-eight tests; forty-one tests; one in two and one in six; two hundred two out of two hundred two; seven thousand knots; two hundred fifty-one texts; nine thousand parts; four hundred fourteen thousand lines; one hundred twenty call sites; D1 through D7; "almost nothing."

Internal mismatches, not merely missing files:

- "The house behind the slide" says sixteen logos and "every one of them," then names fifteen, one of them conditional ("if the unconfirmed P logo is really them"). One logo is unnamed. The same sixteen is repeated in "The pour, said correctly." The census does not add up.
- "GPS is the keystone, honestly" says "a fifth of the cost" and "the score did not move." CORRECTION restates those as "roughly a fifth" and "no-router ablation ties," and renames the system "Scrouting/SuperScout" against the body's "SuperScout." The fix note claims every element resolves. The paste shows a precision and naming slip, not a match.
- "best 2026 result" is a superlative. CORRECTION cites one memo item plus one DIGEST row. One row cannot certify "best." arXiv:2608.04804 is only a pointer here. Existence and the ablation numbers are UNPROVEN.
- Byte-check "words=1200" is scoped, inside its own line, to a count taken before CORRECTION was appended. The DOC as pasted is therefore not 1200 words. Whether the pre-append essay was 1200 is UNPROVEN in this pass. Em-dash claim: no U+2014 seen on a visual scan. That is not a numeric-citation pass.

"yesterday's 0.9" in "GPS is the keystone, honestly" is an illustration, not a measured rate. Not scored as a fake statistic.

POWER

3/10. The thesis in "What we already hold" and the close of "The pour, said correctly" (we already hold the truth organ; nobody else has it) is canceled by the birth-defect paragraph in "GPS is the keystone, honestly." What remains is a plan, a slogan era-name, and a self-cite. Under hostile reading the memo does not establish a thing being built. It establishes a ledger that can lie and a seat defined so the lie still counts as occupancy.

THREE WEAKEST CLAIMS

1. "the only meter in the market" and "the truth about who can do the work" ("What we already hold"; restated in "The pour, said correctly"). "The house behind the slide" stacks the empty-seat test as self-hosted plus eval-gated plus receipt-backed pass-rates plus cost-truth, then reports the seat empty with no search log, date bound, or exclusion list. Vorflux is already cast as the billing office in that same section, so "nobody is building the meter" is a definitional exclusion, not a finding. The next load-bearing section then confesses unverified evidence hashes, trivially inflatable pass-rates, and no decay. A ledger with those defects is not truth, and it is not a meter in the sense just used to clear the market. "Twenty-eight tests green" does not repair a defect the tests are not claimed to cover.

2. The tiered-delegation result is the keystone proof ("GPS is the keystone, honestly"). Even if the missing memo says what CORRECTION asserts, the stated ablation is that removing the router did not move the score, and that the handoff carried the result. That is evidence against routing-as-product. It is not evidence that receipted measurement moved anything. "Best," "a fifth," and "did not move" are doing work the cited restatement does not underwrite. The pivot from "the route is just a query" to "the keystone function is receipted measurement" is an unargued substitution.

3. "two hundred two out of two hundred two green: play is provable, and nobody else's platform can say that sentence" ("What we already hold"). Green tests are not a proof. A hash-chained ledger plus a passing suite does not show play is provable against a motivated writer of tapes. "Nobody else can say that sentence" is an absolute with no survey. The same section treats a training queue ("queued for training in October"), "lines of experience never spent," and a private repo as organs already held. Unused lines and a private repo are not a body or a surface.

THREE DUMB RULES

None survive.

1. Route on receipts, not labels ("Three dumb rules"). Fails cold start: no row means no work means no row, which cuts against "whatever free intelligence walks in" in "The pour, said correctly." "Measurably does" is undefined, and the birth defect already says a numeric row is trivially inflatable, so a row is still a label. Task shape is undefined, so a nearby stale row still routes. The confessed no-decay bug is not in the rule, so the law as written does not stop "yesterday's 0.9 routes today's traffic." The rule also rations work, which "The pour, said correctly" denies ("never rations what walks out"). The ablation the memo itself cites says pulling the router did not move the score. A gate that the cited result says is idle is not a mechanical law of competence.

2. No verdict without evidence bytes ("Three dumb rules"). Stated as already lethal ("kills the inflatable ledger") while "GPS is the keystone, honestly" says the live path binds verdicts to unverified hashes. The rule is unbuilt. As specified it still fails: "a checkable artifact, a tape hash or a test run" does not say who may write the artifact. The worker under test can supply the bytes. A hash of a tautology checks. Binding moves the mean without establishing truth. No decay, no independence, no challenge-before-mean. "Checkable" is not "true."

3. Same row everywhere ("Three dumb rules"). "Already share it" is UNPROVEN; no schema is in the paste. Shared column names are not shared estimands. A model pass-rate, an agent-on-play score, and a player-round verdict do not become one quantity by grammar. "One shape means the house composes" does not follow. Unification makes the confessed inflation bug travel into routing, play, and rounds. Composition needs failure semantics and an independent judge. Column alignment is not that.

Section 1 says the estate is "one organism with five organs, closed into a loop" and that water "became the circulatory system." Section 3 says the return leg has no live traffic, the mates have no heartbeat, and rung 1 is designed, not built. Closure is false on this document's own terms. The thin spots still ask how to finish the loop. That is the wrong question. Whether the repo already quarantines rows, splits replay from live input, or names an outside void is UNPROVEN. This synthesis does not ask.

1. Self-sample treated as judgment. Highest leverage: it defines every later route.
Exposing line, Section 2: "receipts re-enter the ledger as verdict rows".
Section 2 says that baseline "defines the meter." Section 4 treats the first feed as success because "the meter gets real traffic." A receipt from the organ that did the work is not a verdict, and row count is not a judgment.
Question: Which rows are forbidden from moving Wilson LB, n_min, and G0-G3, and who is disqualified from lifting that ban?

2. Live drive and determinism sold as one tie. Next: it decides whether tomorrow's rows are even candidates for 1.
Exposing line, Section 4: "determinism law intact" in the same sentence as "drive it from the live server" and the first production feed into the gps ledger.
Section 1 calls the world an "authoritative hash-chained water world." A live byte outside that chain cannot underwrite an authoritative price. The synthesis never splits the claims.
Question: Which bytes of a live session sit outside the fixed point, and what verdict status is legal when a priced outcome depends on them?

3. No principal outside the payoff, and no split in the only planned change. Last: without it, 1 and 2 do not survive Section 4.
Exposing line, Section 4: "the mates' static-runner fix rides the same commit."
Section 1's five organs all sit inside the loop that commit turns on. A stop that depends on a mate reading STEER.md is not a stop. Section 3 already says that file has no reader.
Question: What condition, checked by something that holds no mission pack and writes no verdict row, aborts the feed alone and leaves the other two ties unshipped?
